worldcombat.skill.retaliate.summary: Avenge a fainted ally: charge straight at the enemy; if an ally just fell, this blow doubles, and the closer the fallen ally the heavier it lands, spent only once it connects.
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.use.0: Hit back the moment an ally falls
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.use.1: Deliver a doubled charge carrying the grief
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.use.2: Charge the enemy that just struck your ally
The charge deals about %1$s physical (Normal) damage to one enemy on contact; if an ally just fell this blow doubles, scaling with level and friendship.
Charges up to %1$s blocks toward the target at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block hit radius; a living target is shoved %4$s blocks, while a miss or a blocked path stops you there.
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.solemn.on: Current: Solemn — charge farther x1.12 and a x1.06 grief multiplier, but base power x0.92 with longer prepare and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.solemn.off: Current: Direct — base x1.08 with a short, clean charge.

worldcombat.skill.retaliate.growth.0: At level %1$s the retribution power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.growth.1: At level %1$s the retribution power rises to %2$s and the charge to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.preference.s: On: charge farther x1.12 and a x1.06 grief multiplier, but base power x0.92, +3 prepare and +8 cooldown. Off: base x1.08 with a short, clean charge.
worldcombat.skill.retaliate.preference.a: Only charge when the target is within this distance; raise it to chase farther targets.
On: while carrying the grief, prioritise the remembered killer; off: attack the current target.
When an ally falls within 20 blocks you and other nearby living allies gain Grief and remember the killer for 8 seconds; while you carry it the blow is multiplied, a landed hit consumes it at once, and a miss keeps it until the window ends.
